decisions.publicReleaseZip: Thin site/admin/server/checksum bundle. Platform downloads are not embedded.
decisions.downloadsDeployment: Windows WebUI, macOS WebUI, and Linux service artifacts are uploaded as a checked downloads source and copied into the staged release only after size and SHA256 validation.
decisions.onlineUpdateGate: Deploying artifacts stages a release; user-visible stable updates require an explicit admin promotion trigger.
decisions.backgroundUpdateUx: Background updates run with ECOREX_UPDATE_MODE=background, defer when /api/active-requests reports running work, do not open a new browser, and leave soft refresh to the existing tab after health is restored.
decisions.platformRuntime: Windows and macOS keep platform-specific binary layers. They share the same manifest contract, cache/sha validation semantics, update-state file, active-request idle gate, and installer flow instead of forcing one cross-platform runtime binary.
